artboards.title: Detached — browser + IDE as two windows

annotations.text: AGWeb, browser-first. Top-left: pure browsing — zero dev chrome, just a Deck button. Right: two directions for how the Dev Deck appears. A (Stage): the page scales back into a spotlit stage and blocks dock around it. B (Overlay): glass blocks float over the page. The second-row left artboard is interactive — click its Deck button to play the reveal/hide animation (Direction A choreography).
Interactive: click the Deck button (top right of this artboard) to toggle the reveal. Stage retreats, blocks slide in staggered; click again to hide.

Blocks stack: drop one onto another to make a tabbed group (see the bottom dock — Terminal 1 / Terminal 2 / Logs). Any block type can have multiple instances; + opens another. The pop-out button beside Deck detaches the whole deck into its own window.

Detached mode: one click pops the entire deck out as a standalone IDE window (files, tabbed editors, stacked terminals) while the browser returns to pure browsing — two apps, two monitors if you like. Dock back re-merges them into the single-window Stage layout.
